narr: A weak upper level disturbance interacted with deep moisture over the Brush Country to produce scattered thunderstorms during the evening hours. A thunderstorm, producing locally heavy rainfall over the city of Laredo, caused flooding of numerous streets on the south side of Laredo.
ev: Flooding of numerous streets and intersections occurred on the east and south side of the Laredo.
Public weather station recorded 3.66 inches in under an hour with a storm total near 4.5 inches. This caused flooding of roads on the south side of Laredo.
lsr: Flooding of numerous streets/intersection throughout the city of Laredo. Time estimated based on radar.
Public weather station recorded 3.66 inches in under an hour with a storm total of 4.45 inches.
